title: Arm-only/dry-run booking gate for safe live validation
description: ConfirmSlot POSTs /3/book unconditionally (book.go:173); the first successful test of the email-alert flow is a real committed reservation. Add engine.WithBookingDryRun(): in RunBookingRace, after the first successful PrepareSlot (proves Find + venue + book_token mint), log the would-book slot and transition Booking->Canceled (reason=dry_run_armed) instead of calling ConfirmSlot. Thread the flag through the watch config and snipe CLI so the path can be validated end-to-end without committing a reservation.
acceptance_criteria: dry-run runs Find+Prepare then cancels without /3/book; flag exposed on watch config + snipe; engine test asserts ConfirmSlot is never called in dry-run
close_reason: Implemented: ImportSession + login --token + auto-seed fallback; engine.WithBookingDryRun gate (watch dry_run + -dry-run-booking). Tests green incl -race.

title: Auth bridge: import RESY_AUTH_TOKEN as a Resy session
description: RESY_AUTH_TOKEN in .env is dead config (grep: never read). The booking path authenticates only via loadSessionForSnipe -> LoadSession, which reads a JWT already persisted in the SQLite store. The only writer is Client.Login (password flow), blocked by the CompleteMFA Phase-1 stub. Result: hand-grabbed JWT never reaches the store, every watch entry is skipped at prepareWatchIntent, and email-alert auto-booking never arms. Add resy.ImportSession(user, token) (reuse parseJWTExp + UpsertSession), a 'resy-snipe login --token' command (verify-live via Ping), and an auto-seed fallback in loadSessionForSnipe when RESY_AUTH_TOKEN is set and the store has no live session.
acceptance_criteria: login --token persists a session; loadSessionForSnipe auto-seeds from RESY_AUTH_TOKEN; expired token gives a clear error; tests cover import + auto-seed + expired
close_reason: Implemented: ImportSession + login --token + auto-seed fallback; engine.WithBookingDryRun gate (watch dry_run + -dry-run-booking). Tests green incl -race.
